newsitem.title: USA: FP&L sees Fla. nuke at 100 pct this wknd.
newsitem.headline: FP&L sees Fla. nuke at 100 pct this wknd.

text.p: Florida Power and Light Co's 666 megawatt (MW) Turkey Point 3 nuclear power unit will likely return to full power this weekend, the company said Friday morning.

"They found a small steam leak on one of the feedwater pumps. They're doing inspections and testing. The unit is expected to return to full power in the next day or so," company spokeswoman Janice Brady said.
The unit, in Florida City, Fla., was reduced to 55 percent power at about 1800 EST Thursday, she said.
The adjacent unit, Turkey Point 4, was operating at its full 666 MW capacity.
Florida Power and Light is a subsidiary of the FPL Group.
